# Bhalaji Yadav Kantepalle — Research Portfolio

> Public academic portfolio for a Ph.D. student in Integrative Life Sciences at Virginia Commonwealth University studying stimuli-responsive soft and liquid-crystalline materials through quantitative metrology, rheology, neutron scattering, mechanics, and reproducible computation.

## Primary pages
- [About Bhalaji Yadav Kantepalle](https://bhalaji.com/about/): Research biography, professional path, current scientific focus, methods, and persistent profile links.
- [Research program](https://bhalaji.com/research/): Scientific questions, measurement strategy, structure under processing, reproducibility, and collaboration directions.
- [Research outputs](https://bhalaji.com/outputs/): Complete reverse-chronological record of peer-reviewed articles, thesis, citable research software, and patent-pending intellectual property.
- [First-author article](https://bhalaji.com/publication/adhesives-wearable/): Multi-criteria adhesive selection for wearable textiles.
- [M.S. thesis record](https://bhalaji.com/publication/masters-thesis/): Degree and repository information; full manuscript embargoed until July 20, 2031.
- [Research software](https://bhalaji.com/project/peel-trace-evaluation/): Versioned workflow for protocol-defined peel-trace analysis.
- [Quantitative Thermal Imaging](https://bhalaji.com/project/quantitative-thermal-imaging/): Patent-pending intellectual-property record, VCU Tech # TAN-26-099.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://bhalaji.com/uploads/resume.pdf): Complete academic and professional record.
